# Fixture origin and modifications

This fixture is derived from the HSF Community White Paper “Data Analysis and Interpretation,” fixed at upstream commit `2c490743982a0033f148f57bd16913287e3c3e4f`.

Original source: <https://github.com/HSF/documents/blob/2c490743982a0033f148f57bd16913287e3c3e4f/CWP/papers/HSF-CWP-2017-05_analysis/latex/cwp-wg-analysis-interpretation.tex>

Copyright © 2018, The HSF Community White Paper authors. Licensed under CC-BY-4.0.

Modifications: the author and affiliation list, figures, most sections, and JHEP-specific presentation were removed; bibliography paths were localized; the retained introduction was split with `\input`. No artificial coverage syntax was added.
